summary: Client one-frame request to attach an entity as a child of an HLOD (hierarchical level-of-detail proxy). Drained by ls::HLODSystem::UpdateAddRequests (GameEngine.dll+0x1659E0): it converts the Guid at +0 to a FixedString and looks it up in the system's HLOD map (macOS ls::HLODSystem::GetHLOD(ls::Guid const&)), then checks the Guid at +0x10 against two Guid sets of the level (FUN_1801532f0 at level +0x28/+0x38) and logs it with Guid::ToString when missing. Seen alive on level change / level-swap teleport.
